fact: Goobo Labs of Mogadishu released whisper-som-small, a Somali speech-recognition checkpoint fine-tuned on 320 hours of Somali audio from its SomNLP-STT-Corpus, reporting 11.4% word error rate on its own radio test set.

The SIMAD AI Institute's Natural Language Processing for Somalia project is in phased development, including dataset preparation and prototype model development for Somali text and speech (SIMAD AI Institute).
Sykli Intelligence's founder presented Himilo 7B, a Somali language model, saying it is still being evaluated and that open-sourcing is a goal.

Dawan Africa reports that SIMAD University laid the foundation stone on 5 November 2026 for a building to host Somalia's National AI Hub, with the communications minister, built by Hadiid Group, to offer AI research and training on building AI-powered systems.

Africa Insight reports that the Somali-Language AI & Innovation Lab (SAIL) and a Somali fake-news detection project were launched in Mogadishu on 6 April 2026 with Jamhuuriya University of Science and Technology as partner.

Jamhuriya University of Science and Technology, with the University of Djibouti, launched the Somali-language AI and Innovation Lab (SAIL) on 7 April 2026, and its researchers unveiled the SomBERTa model for detecting fake Somali news at 98 per cent accuracy, said to be available to media organisations and policymakers soon.
